scope: Mappings for unchanged saved columns; not an additional experiment or independent dataset.

D14.system: phase_* denotes repaired A.1 continuous-vector circular conditions; original phase elsewhere may denote the obsolete angular implementation.
D14.shift_all: Transformed-target accuracy, not all-trial output agreement.
D14.permutation_all: Transformed-target accuracy, not D18 reordered-output agreement.
D14.gates: Operational implementation checks, not independent learned-mechanism proof.
D14.invariance_preserved: One minus the maximum sequence_change_rate across the corresponding listed invariance checks; an operational summary, distinct from cursor shift/permutation interventions.

variants.oracle_slots: TARGET_INFORMED: task-rank reference code; circular full-circle layout is not compatible with native cosine Competitive.
variants.source_rank_uniform: SOURCE_INFERRED: externally inferred source order embedded uniformly; circular layout uses full circle.
variants.metric_distorted: TARGET_RANK_PRESERVED: Scan-only cubic reconstruction from target ranks.
variants.slot_snapped: SOURCE_NEAREST_SLOT: Scan-only label-free independent snapping; duplicate slots may remain.
variants.semicircle: TARGET_INFORMED: circular Competitive, target ranks embedded on oriented semicircle.
variants.learned_span_arc: TARGET_INFORMED: target ranks embedded on source occupied span capped at pi minus 1e-4; not width-only intervention.
variants.inferred_semicircle: SOURCE_INFERRED: native projected-score order externally ranked and embedded on oriented semicircle.
variants.source_rank_cubic: SOURCE_RANK_PRESERVED: scalar Competitive, externally inferred source order rebuilt on cubic coordinates.

D35.boundary: Externally computed source or target ranks do not show that a rank-to-coordinate algorithm was learned.

D37_D38.relationship: Byte-identical intentional aliases of the same geometry summaries, written under two filenames by experiment_a3/analyze.py. They are not independent evidence.

historical_labels.original_Experiment_A: scan denotes original nonrejecting reference reader (whose output was largely reproduced by masked sorting in saved diagnostics); phase denotes wrapped atan2 coordinates, not the repaired normalized vector.
historical_labels.repaired_A1_and_A3: Within repaired A.1 calibration and its A.3-derived analyses, scan denotes the rejecting fixed-reference reader and phase the repaired continuous-vector circular representation. Scalar Competitive source checkpoints in A.3 remain unchanged original-A models.
historical_labels.boundary: Identical labels across stages do not imply identical implementations. Source/run paths establish the cohort.
historical_labels.A1_old_scan_exception: The A.1 old_scan audit (D16; source runs/experiment_A1/old_scan) instead probes original-A models; its scan/phase labels retain the original implementations.
historical_labels.A2: A.2 analytical oracle/noise tables (D19-D30) use the repaired A.1 reader equations cloned in experiment_a2/analysis.py: rejecting fixed-reference Scan and vector/cosine circular Competitive. Constructed phase codes are unit vectors, not original-A wrapped scalar phase. Learned endpoint rows use saved A.1 calibration outputs; original angular Phase is not substituted.

D12.scope: Post-calibration saved-code noncyclic cursor diagnostic retained in results/experiment_A1; a later experiment-stage check, not a new model training run. The D-versus-A01/A02 namespace distinguishes retained stage outputs from manuscript-preparation audits, not confirmatory versus exploratory evidence.
